name: HypeScript
description: 🐬 A simplified implementation of TypeScript's type system written in TypeScript's type system

paragraphs: This is a simplified implementation of TypeScript's type system that's written in TypeScript's type annotations. This means that it uses types only — with no runtime code whatsoever.
You pass TypeScript code as a string to the TypeCheck generic and get possible type errors back (See the live demo):
☝ Please note that this project is meant to be used for fun and learning purposes and not for practical use.
